title: ExiST: Existence-Aware Self-Training for Semi-Supervised Multi-Organ Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semi-supervised multi-organ segmentation should learn more than a dozen organs from a handful of labeled scans, and the smallest organs occupy less than one percent of the foreground. We identify a failure mode of self-training that is specific to this regime. When a teacher misses a small organ in a scan, every voxel of that organ receives the confident pseudo-label background, and the student is trained toward the organ absence. Repeated over many scans, this loop extinguishes tail organs. In a pilot study, removing the gallbladder from the pseudo-labels reduced its Dice on AMOS from 36.5 to 1.0. We argue that a missing organ should be treated as unresolved rather than absent and propose Existence-aware Self-Training (ExiST). It builds pseudo-labels by leave-one-out consensus of independently trained networks, screens them with a quality gate on validation scans, and infers, per scan and per organ, whether the organ was found. translated_title: ExiST：面向半监督多器官分割的存在感知自训练
translated_abstract: 半监督多器官分割需要从少量有标注的扫描中学习十多个器官，而其中最小的器官仅占前景的不到百分之一。我们识别出这一特定场景下自训练的一种失效模式：当教师模型在某次扫描中漏检了一个小器官时，该器官的每一个体素都会被赋予置信度极高的“背景”伪标签，学生模型便朝着“该器官不存在”的方向被训练。在大量扫描上反复迭代后，这一循环会逐渐“抹除”长尾器官。在一项初步研究中，将胆囊从伪标签中移除后，其在AMOS数据集上的Dice分数从36.5骤降至1.0。我们主张，一个未被找到的器官应被视为“未确定”而非“不存在”，并据此提出存在感知自训练方法ExiST。该方法通过独立训练的网络之间的留一法共识构建伪标签，利用在验证扫描上的质量门控对伪标签进行筛选，并针对每次扫描、每个器官推断该器官是否被找到。对于……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 针对半监督多器官分割中教师模型漏检小器官导致学生被训练为“器官不存在”、进而使长尾器官被逐步抹除的失效模式，论文提出存在感知自训练ExiST，通过留一法共识构建伪标签、质量门控筛选并逐扫描逐器官推断器官是否存在。
en_tdlr: ExiST introduces existence-aware self-training that builds leave-one-out consensus pseudo-labels with quality gating and infers per-scan organ existence, preventing tail organs from being extinguished when the teacher misses small organs in semi-supervised multi-organ segmentation.
